probes.probe_description: Shifts input bar timestamps forward by 1 bar to detect lookahead bias
Injects +/- 2 bps gaussian price noise to test parameter fragility
Doubles execution fee and slippage penalties to measure fee vulnerability
Tests +/- 10% moving window variations to detect parameter cliff overfitting
Evaluates candidate against high-volatility 2020 and 2022 market regime stress periods
